related.title: Bloom filter：誤判機率與刪除限制
related.titleEn: Bloom filters: false positives and deletion limits
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付codebook.csv、merge-trace及round-trip；15 bits不含codebook與封裝成本。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver codebook.csv, merge traces and round-trips; fifteen bits excludes codebook and framing overhead. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 逐hash標bit，建立真實集合oracle；query陽性仍需查真實資料，陰性只有在模型前提成立時才可排除。
related.differenceEn: Set bits per hash and keep an exact-set oracle; positives require exact lookup, while negatives rely on the model’s premises.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
Huffman反覆合併最小頻率建前綴樹；相同頻率可有不同碼字但相同最佳成本，驗收不應固定某一位元串。
本課數值核對：2+4+9 = 15 bits；另一項核對：9*2 = 18 bits。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

標準Bloom filter允許false positive而無設計內false negative；清除共享bit可能導致false negative，因此刪除需其他設計。
本課數值核對：(1-exp(-7*100/1000))**7 = 0.00819372206586 probability；另一項核對：(1-exp(-7*200/1000))**7 = 0.137781707292 probability。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Huffman repeatedly merges minimum frequencies into a prefix tree; ties can produce different codes with equal optimal cost, so acceptance should not fix one bit pattern.
Numeric audit: 2+4+9 = 15 bits; second audit: 9*2 = 18 bits. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Standard Bloom filters allow false positives but no designed false negatives; clearing shared bits can create false negatives, so deletion needs another design.
Numeric audit: (1-exp(-7*100/1000))**7 = 0.00819372206586 probability; second audit: (1-exp(-7*200/1000))**7 = 0.137781707292 probability. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: CBOR：主型別、短整數與二進位交換
related.titleEn: CBOR: major types, short integers and binary interchange

related.difference: 分離major type與低五bits，先讀長度再讀payload；逐項記offset避免跨界。
related.differenceEn: Separate major type from the low five bits, read lengths before payloads and trace offsets to prevent overruns.

CBOR初始byte包含major type與additional information；同樣數值可有不同編碼，確定性編碼另有約束。
